candidates.explanation: The offset is computed as page * limit, but pages are 1-based. Page 1 with limit 10 skips 10 rows, so the list starts at the 11th user. With only two seeded users it returns nothing. Page 2 skips 20 rows, so it starts at the 21st user. The document repository correctly uses (page - 1) * limit.

fix.description: Use a 1-based page offset: skip: (paginationOptions.page - 1) * paginationOptions.limit
